g.text: Request readiness, confidence, and explanation data
Build result for selected spot and species
Load saved spot context when relevant
Load species-specific timing and sensitivity rules
Load recent weather evidence for the spot
Load seasonal observation evidence near the spot
Read stored taxon ID for supported species
Read derived evidence by taxon, spot, radius, and time policy
Search observations by taxon ID, spot, radius, and time policy
Store processed seasonal evidence with TTL
[Live refresh fails but stale cache is reusable]
Stale processed seasonal evidence with freshness limitation
Combine seasonal, weather, and species-profile factors
Readiness label, probability, confidence, and explanation inputs
Show main result and deeper explanation views
Fall back to static seasonal timing when observation evidence is weak or unavailable
Low-confidence or unavailable result with missing-data reasons
Search taxon and save supported species
Search and confirm external taxon identity
Create or update supported species entry with stored taxon ID
Detailed expert submission and approval workflow
This diagram only fixes the stable boundary where
species-specific rules are stored and adjusted.
Supported species store the external taxon ID
Runtime readiness must not call taxon search.
Initial shortcut: in-memory cache if needed.
If seasonal evidence is sparse, missing, or unavailable
without reusable stale cache, the service falls back
to the static species calendar and lowers confidence.
